canonical_name: Network Isolation for High-Value Assets Not Implemented
description: High-value assets are not isolated on dedicated network segments. This signal indicates that critical systems may be accessible through compromised standard network segments.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments with high-value assets. Includes network micro-segmentation, isolated management networks, and air-gapped systems for critical assets.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through network architecture review, micro-segmentation verification, and high-value asset isolation assessment.
